title: Petition of Paxton Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in the rate of depreciation from the statutory rate of three percent to five percent for the year 2003.
filings: ORDER ISSUED- By Commissioners Afonso (Chairman), Connelly, Keating, Sullivan, Mannning. DTE 04-28-D

Petition of the Paxton Municipal Light Department for approval to set their depreciation rate for calendar year 2003 to five percent cost of utility plant in service January 1, 2003 less cost of land and land rights. By Diane K. Dillman, Manager. DTE 04-28-D
